interface.longDescription: A local privacy check before a directory or selected Git history goes public: finds recognized patterns such as home-directory paths inside xlsx files, usernames in Python bytecode and personal addresses. Use when preparing to push to a public repository, make a private repo public or share a bundle. Scans directory files regardless of extension, excluding .git; opens supported archives up to three levels and selected PDF streams, and applies byte patterns to binaries. --git-range additionally checks selected commits' authors, committers, messages and added/modified blobs. Loaded allow-file comments are also scanned, including outside the directory. Personal identifiers come from a private config. GREEN means no unapproved RED match in scanned material, not complete inspection or publication clearance. Use a credential scanner as well and inspect images yourself.
